title: No World
description: Wake up with no memory. Explore myhouse enter the inthewood dimension and uncover your lost past
body:
You wake up with no memory in a strange land. The only thing you recognize is a small house called myhouse standing alone in a clearing. Something about it feels familiar but you cant remember why. As you step outside you see a strange portal with twisted runes carved into its frame. A villager in a dark cloak a new profession whispers to you. Beyond this portal lies inthewood the dimension where your past is hidden. You hesitate then step through.

You fall into a mysterious dimension known as inthewood. A realm ruled by two beings. No the silent watcher and Wood the ancient guardian. Wood naturally spawns throughout this dark forest protecting the dimension from intruders. Scattered across the realm you find ancient crosses. Remnants of a forgotten faith perhaps tied to your lost memory. Deep within this dangerous realm lies a rare and valuable ore called the Fake Diamond. Its not a real diamond but a mysterious crystal that pulses with unknown energy. Fake Diamond can also be found in the Overworld but its much rarer there. Making the inthewood dimension the best place to mine it. Players who brave the dimension and defeat its guardians are rewarded with this unique material.
